post.summary: Create a cut (カット) under a scene. Initializes cut.stageStatus to all 'pending' and allocates path-based DID did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:cut:{rkey}. Sequential addCut calls on the same scene auto-increment cutNum if omitted.

episodeId.description: Optional; derived from scene if omitted.

cutNum.description: Auto-incremented within the episode if omitted.

post.summary: Create an episode record (com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.episode) and bootstrap its project (convoId). The episode inherits work.fps unless overridden. Emits social announcement via derive rule on status transition.

Invoke the finisher AI actor to auto-color-trace a keyframe or inbetween frame using the given color model. Produces com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.colorTrace record with method='aiAutoTrace' and status='review'.

Stage 2/12 — Break a scene into 3-8 cuts via Qwen 7B (mid tier). Persists a sceneBreakdown plan row (cuts array in description). UI/caller fanouts addCut per entry. Backed by BPMN animeka_breakdown_scene (ADR-2604231328).

Send a chat message to one of the 12 animeka actors (or broadcast to director when actorSlug omitted). Writes the user turn + the actor reply as com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.chatMessage records scoped to the episode convoId, and returns the reply synchronously for UI rendering.

actorSlug.description: One of: director, screenwriter, storyboarder, layout, keyAnimator, inbetweener, colorDesigner, finisher, bgArtist, compositor, soundDesigner, editor. Omit for broadcast (director).

convoId.description: Optional: project convoId override. Defaults to episode convoId lookup or the slug itself.

sender.description: Display name of the responding actor.

post.summary: Create an anime work (series). Kysely-direct write to vertex_animeka_work + registers path-based DID did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:work:{slug}.
Stage 7/12 — Design a color model (palette + character color chart) for a character. Typically invoked once per character. Backed by BPMN animeka_design_color_model (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 9/12 — Generate a painterly anime background (FLUX.1-dev, 1920x1080). Derive rule fires on layout.status=approved in parallel with keyframe gen. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_background (ADR-2604231328).

Invoke the inbetweener AI actor to interpolate in-between frames between two keyframes on the same cut + layerRole. Creates com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.inbetween records with method='aiInterp' and status='review'.

count.description: Number of in-between frames to generate.

videoBackend.description: Video generation backend on the RunPod GPU pod (ADR-2604231328). Default seedance2 — ByteDance Seedance 2 i2v retains character identity across long interpolations better than WAN 5B.

post.summary: Stage 5/12 — Generate a single anime keyframe (Animagine XL + ControlNet-pose + IPAdapter character ref). Caller fanouts per key pose. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_keyframe (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 4/12 — Generate a layout paper from an approved storyboard (ControlNet-depth + Animagine 1024x1024). HITL: produces status=draft, director approves downstream. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_layout (ADR-2604231328).
Stage 1/12 — Draft an episode script with Claude Sonnet 4.5 (deep tier), structure scenes via Qwen 7B (mid tier), and persist a script row. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_script (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 11/12 — Generate one sound cue (dialogue via Style-Bert-VITS2 JP / SFX via Stable Audio Open / BGM via MusicGen medium). Caller fanouts per cue. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_sound_cue (ADR-2604231328).

voiceOrPrompt.description: Voice name for dialogue; prompt for sfx/bgm.

post.summary: Stage 3/12 — Generate one storyboard candidate image (Animagine XL 512x512). Caller invokes 3 times (candidateNum=1,2,3); director picks 1 via status=approved gate. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_storyboard (ADR-2604231328).

get.summary: Get a cut with its full layer tree (storyboard, layout, keyframes, inbetweens, colorTrace, background, composite, soundCue, retakes). Drives the Cut Detail view.

post.summary: Health check. Returns app identity + timestamp.

get.summary: List cuts. Powers the Pipeline Board (episode-scoped) and the flat Cuts browser (cross-episode when only workId is given).
List episodes of a work. Uses edge_contains graph traversal from work.
List retakes. Powers the Review Room queue and per-cut retake panel. Default filter is status='open'.

post.summary: Publish or update an episode. Transitions status (typically 'review' → 'delivered' → 'published') and sets masterCid. Transition to 'published' fires the `episode-published-social` derive rule to emit Tier 1 social post (AppBskyFeedPost) authored by the work's path-based DID.

announcementText.description: Optional override for the derived social post body.

post.summary: Invoke the compositor AI actor to render the final composite for a cut. Combines colorTrace frames + background + fxStack + camera move into outputCid. Creates com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.composite record.

previewOnly.description: If true, renders low-res preview and sets status='draft'.

videoBackend.description: Video backend on the RunPod GPU pod (ADR-2604231328). Default seedance2 for faithful camera-move rendering.

post.summary: Mark a retake resolved by pointing at the new record that addresses it. Un-flips cut.priority if no open retakes remain.
Submit a retake (リテイク) against a target record. Creates com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.retake and flips the target cut's priority to 'retake' and the relevant stage status to 'retake'.

cutId.description: Parent cut (derived from targetUri if omitted).

post.summary: Update cut.stageStatus and/or cut.assignees for a single pipeline stage. Drives the Pipeline Board kanban. Stage transition to 'approved' may cascade via derive rules (e.g. storyboard→layout, layout→keyAnim+bg).

bgCid.description: Blob CID of the background image (typ. higher resolution than frame for PAN/TU headroom).

layeredCid.description: Blob CID of the layered BG doc (sky / mid / fore + book layers).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the character reference sheet (front/side/back + expressions).

voiceCast.description: Voice actor DID or name (public credit — Tier 2 ok; private contract data → Tier 3).

body.description: Message body. If prefixed 'signal:v1:' the content is Signal-encrypted (e.g. personal critique).

tool.description: Invoked AI tool name (if this message is an actor response, e.g. 'storyboarder.propose').

lightingCondition.description: Color set is per lighting condition. Multiple colorModel records per character allowed (one per condition).

materialMap.description: Blob CID of the material index image (each pixel = material ID, used by AI segmentation).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the painted reference sheet.

colorLayersCid.description: Blob CID of the layered color doc (base / shadow1 / shadow2 / highlight / rim).

flatCid.description: Blob CID of the flattened colored frame (for preview / composite input).

outputCid.description: Blob CID of the composited cut (mp4 or image sequence).

cutNum.description: Cut number within the episode (1-indexed, globally unique per episode regardless of scene).

durationFrames.description: Cut length in frames. Duration in seconds = durationFrames / fps.

fps.description: Frame rate for this cut (24 full / 12 limited / 8 super-limited). Overrides episode.fps.

dialogueSummary.description: One-line dialogue/action summary for board display.

priority.description: 'retake' = outstanding retake exists; board highlights red.

convoId.description: Project convoId (= roomId). Knowledge graph records in this episode are scoped by this id.

durationSec.description: Target duration in seconds (typ. 1410 = 23m30s for TV).

fps.description: Episode default fps (24 full, 12 limited). Overrides work.fps.

status.description: Pipeline stage indicator (coarse). Per-cut progress lives in `cut.status`.

masterCid.description: Blob CID of the final master video (mp4/mov). Set on delivery.

thumbCid.description: Episode thumbnail. Consumed by derive rule as embed.images[0].

frameNum.description: Frame number within the cut (0-indexed). Must be strictly between prevKey.frameNum and nextKey.frameNum.

method.description: How this frame was produced. 'reuse' = copy of adjacent frame (holdout).

author.description: Human DID or inbetweener actor DID.

imageCid.description: Blob CID of the keyframe drawing.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI layered doc (line + tie-down layers).

layerRole.description: X-sheet layer column (A = foreground / main char, B/C/D = secondary, book = static overlay).

tiePose.description: Pose / expression tag for cross-frame consistency check.

layoutCid.description: Blob CID of the layout drawing (KAMI layered format preferred).

lightingDirection.description: Lighting direction note for finishers (e.g. '上手 45°', 'モノトーン').

convoId.description: Project convo / room id. All knowledge-graph records scoped by this id.

indexCid.description: Optional R2 index blob CID for fast project tree load.

targetUri.description: AT URI of the record being retaken.

stage.description: Pipeline stage the retake applies to.

timecodeFrame.description: Frame pin within the cut (for per-frame comments). Omit for cut-level retake.

author.description: Reviewer DID (typ. director or episode director).

assignee.description: DID expected to fix (overrides cut.assignees if set).

resolvedByUri.description: AT URI of the new record that resolves this retake (e.g. updated keyframe).

headingJP.description: Scene heading (e.g. 'S#12 / 夜 / 校舎屋上').

mood.description: Emotional tone (tense / calm / heroic / melancholy ...). Used by bgArtist lighting design.

cutCount.description: Realized cut count (set after cut breakdown).

bodyCid.description: Blob CID of the script body (.txt / .fountain / .fdx).

format.description: Script format. 'hakoden' = Japanese anime 箱書き format.

sceneCount.description: Parsed scene count (set after scene split).

assetCid.description: Blob CID of the audio asset (wav/ogg/mp3).

line.description: Dialogue text for voice tracks (from script).

thumbCid.description: Blob CID of the storyboard thumbnail sketch.

candidateNum.description: 1..3 if this is one of the AI-proposed candidates; omitted for human-authored single board.

dialogue.description: Dialogue text (JP primary, spoken lines + character attribution).

soundNote.description: SE / BGM hint (e.g. 'SE: 扉を開ける').

durationFramesHint.description: Proposed cut length in frames (refines cut.durationFrames on approval).

genre.description: Primary genre (action / drama / slice-of-life / sci-fi etc.).

episodeCount.description: Planned total episode count (informational; actual episodes are separate com.etzhayyim.apps.animeka.episode records).

fps.description: Default fps for this work (24 for full animation, 12 for limited). Can be overridden per-cut.

coverCid.description: Blob CID of the key visual image. Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image.

trailerUri.description: PV / trailer URL. Emitted as facet#link in the derived post.
